player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Mastermind.
Wo hia kodu a ɛyɛ {code_length} nkyekyɛm de, kwa nkyekyɛm biara fi 1 kosi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
W'akwanso, wo betumi de wo nsaanoɔ wɔ saa format yi mu: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Akyiri kwa nsaanoɔ biara, wo bɛnya feedback wɔ abosodeɛ ne fitaɛ nkyɛkyɛm mu.
Abosodeɛ kɔkɔɔ kyerɛ nkyekyɛm a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ baabi a ɛyɛ pɛ, ɛnna fitaɛ kɔkɔɔ kyerɛ nkyekyɛm a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ baabi a ɛnyɛ pɛ.
Wo wɔ {max_turns} nsaanoɔ sɛ wo bɛnya kodu no.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wamma no mmuae sɛ ɔfã a wɔayi ne baabi ntam, na wɔde akontaahyɛde atoto ntenten mu.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ɛsɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔde ba no nyinaa yɛ anansesɛm.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Wo nwonwa no kwere bɛhwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi de {code_length} nam kakraa mu.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ɛsɛ sɛ ne nyinaa yɛ 1 kosi {num_numbers} ntam.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Wɔmma kwan mma wɔnkyerɛ nnumeroɔ a wɔsan di dwuma bio.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Woda ada {guess}. Mpene so da betere guess.

game_action.feedback: Wo de [{guess}] kɔɔ so. Feedback: {black_pegs} abosodeɛ kɔkɔɔ, {white_pegs} fitaɛ kɔkɔɔ.

outcome.win: Woda asi code no, de {black_pegs} guu {code_length} pegs pɛ
outcome.turn_limit: Ɛho nsεm no adu. Woaka {percent} nkyekyem a w'adi ho dwuma yiye wɔ akontaahyɛde ahorow no mu.
